rationale: Builds on the current reverse-tail recurrent baseline with a compact structural change: tail recurrence now learns a staged blend from the fixed decoder-output anchor toward a running recurrent anchor, using new tail_anchor_gates plus a late anchor curriculum. This spends bytes directly on the winning recurrent-tail path, keeps shapes compile-stable, preserves exact final eval and quant-aware export, and avoids another scalar-only sweep after the recent plateau.
title: Staged Running-Anchor Reverse Tail
